title: Seaside "Heaven Sent" 621 Forest Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Walking distance to the beach- Propane grill- 4 adult bikes - 2 dedicated parking spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover the undeniable charm of Seaside at Heaven Sent, a 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom cottage that comfortably sleeps up to 9 guests. Famous for its carefully designed beach pavilions, Seaside offers guests family-friendly fun at every turn. After a relaxing day on the beach or browsing the shops in Ruskin Place, enjoy a spirited night out at Bud and Alley’s or Great Southern Café. Guests will love that this home is minutes from the beach and all the convenience of this one-of-a-kind beach town!A beautiful white-picket fence and porch with 2 rocking chairs greet guests upon arrival. Inside, white wainscotting and golden wood floors add elegance throughout the home. A huge sectional provides plenty of plush seating for the whole group to relax and watch TV after a day in the sun. Continue into the kitchen, featuring granite countertops, an open layout, and a breakfast bar for 4—perfect for entertaining guests as dinner simmers in the background. A dining table to the side seats up to 8 guests or indulge in an evening meal under the stars at the outdoor table for 6. There is a propane grill for barbecue lovers! Down the hall is the primary bedroom, with a king bed, TV, and access to the backyard. Adjacent is a bonus bunk room, an ideal setup for children, with a twin bed and twin-over twin bunk.The second- floor landing hosts a sitting space with a wicker armchair and café table for 2. On the deck, sip a chilled lemonade and take in the serene scenery. There are 2 well-appointed guest bedrooms on this level, with a king bed and a queen bed, respectively.Savor the splendor of a sunny Seaside getaway at Heaven Sent. There is parking for 2 vehicles—plus 4 complimentary adult bikes—making it easy to explore the area at a leisurely pace. Beach access is available at all of Seaside’s pavilions. Book this delightful home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENT (Sleeps 9):FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Includes Two Twin Beds in attached Bonus Room), Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Bonus Room: One Twin and one Twin/Twin bunk Bed (Attached to Primary Bedroom), Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Unfortunately, the HOA in this community prohibits Low-Speed Vehicle rentals or for guests to bring their own.

Famous for its carefully designed beach pavilions, Seaside offers guests family-friendly fun at every turn. After a relaxing day on the beach or browsing the shops in Ruskin Place, enjoy a spirited night out at Bud and Alley’s or Great Southern Café. Guests will love that this home is minutes from the beach and all the convenience of this one-of-a-kind beach town! A beautiful white-picket fence and porch with 2 rocking chairs greet guests upon arrival. Inside, white wainscotting and golden wood floors add elegance throughout the home. A huge sectional provides plenty of plush seating for the whole group to relax and watch TV after a day in the sun. Continue into the kitchen, featuring granite countertops, an open layout, and a breakfast bar for 4—perfect for entertaining guests as dinner simmers in the background. A dining table to the side seats up to 8 guests or indulge in an evening meal under the stars at the outdoor table for 6. There is a propane grill for barbecue lovers! Down the hall is the primary bedroom, with a king bed, TV, and access to the backyard. Adjacent is a bonus bunk room, an ideal setup for children, with a twin bed and twin-over twin bunk. The second- floor landing hosts a sitting space with a wicker armchair and café table for 2. On the deck, sip a chilled lemonade and take in the serene scenery. There are 2 well-appointed guest bedrooms on this level, with a king bed and a queen bed, respectively. Savor the splendor of a sunny Seaside getaway at Heaven Sent. There is parking for 2 vehicles—plus 4 complimentary adult bikes—making it easy to explore the area at a leisurely pace. Beach access is available at all of Seaside’s pavilions. Book this delightful home today!
